Usage: phoenix-ui update [options]

Update an existing Phoenix UI skill installation.
A project update reruns the project install with this bundle.

Options:
  --project [<dir>]      Update the current or given project installation (default)
  --user, --global       Update the user-level installation (also --scope=global)
  -y, --yes              User level: accept detected defaults without prompting
  --no-hooks             User level: update skills without changing hook manifests
  --force                User level: replace installed skill files
  --dry-run              Project: report the plan without writing
  --bundle-root=<path>   Explicit local bundle; also PHOENIX_UI_BUNDLE_PATH
  --json                 Project: report as one JSON object
  -h, --help             Show this help message
